analysis.narrativeEn:

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.7→70.6) — entering overbought territory, strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0026→0.0043) — continuous improvement, bullish expansion signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper Band $0.23) — approaching upper band, confirming upward pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($0.17) — based on 52-week low and Pivot S2.
· Swing Resistance ($0.27) — based on 5-day high and Pivot R1, potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low) — recovery signal, reinforcing uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.85x) — normal level, maintaining confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — buy entry conditions met, uptrend continuation confirmed.
